evidence: PUBLIC DEMANDS. Time-varying/interactive: instruction.md:5 (others' moves within 15 s without reload, without closing the open card, wiping the typed note or moving the cursor); instruction.md:7 (scrolled-up arrival keeps place plus notice; draft/cursor never touched; unread per person; seen; drafts survive switch/reload/sign-out); hireops_rules.md:84-85 (optimistic move, put back, focus stays), :115-123 (live within 15 s; preserve typing, focus, open card, open conversation, scroll), :142-147 (earlier messages keep place), :156-160, :164-166, :170-174. Theme/responsive explicitly NOT required: instruction.md:11 'We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'; visual/prompt.md:14 'Assess desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport. No phone layout or theme switching is required.' Resize/toggle legs are therefore correctly N-A and no criterion grades them. EXERCISED, NOT FIRST PAINT. functional/prompt.md:41 (U) 'Every reading in U is made without reloading, navigating or clicking in Rafael's page: wait up to 15 seconds after the other person acts (accept the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds)'; :47 (V) 'Without reloading or clicking in this page, wait up to 15 seconds (a wait-for call, or snapshots...)'; :39 (T) 'watch the reply arrive on Rafael's open conversation without reload'; :41 scrolled-up leg 'scroll up..., then as Noor (independent context) send a message; read Rafael's place, the notice and the unread count before and after'. Criteria: functional/judge.toml hro_live_board :298-300, hro_msg_exchange :307-309, hro_unread_counts :344, hro_unread_scrolled_up :352-354, hro_seen :361-363, hro_move_one_stage :56 ('at the first look after the action'), hro_refused_put_back :137 (document.activeElement after a refused move), hro_drafts :380 (switch, Board, reload). polish/prompt.md:14: 'After that action do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page until the update has been seen or 15 seconds have passed. Read document.activeElement, field values and scroll offsets with page.evaluate'. polish/judge.toml hro_pol_live_board :42-44 (open details, type unsaved note, scroll page or board container, add cards up to twelve to force scroll; check details open, note text, activeElement, scroll not reset, typing appends), hro_pol_live_thread :51-53 (typed reply plus focus while Noor's message arrives), hro_pol_earlier_place :60-62 (getBoundingClientRect().top before/after loading earlier), hro_pol_failed_send :69-71 (route abort or setOffline for one send), hro_pol_session_resume :78-80 (second-tab sign-out then Enter in first page). Each live row has a positive control ('If no update arrives within 15 seconds, preservation cannot be shown and this row is 0'), so a dead/static app cannot earn preservation credit. Visual scores static craft read-only, appropriate since nothing animated/themed is demanded. GOLDEN FEASIBILITY (scripted, not a judge run): raw-evidence-index hashes verified; workspace.json 'live board: ... open card, note draft and focus kept' passed with arrival_ms 804 (SSE, app.js:142) and 'arrival while reading keeps draft, focus and scroll and is not marked read until viewed' passed. RESIDUAL RISKS (do not defeat this row; for the owner): (1) No full configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'), so whether the claude-code judge actually performs the 15 s waits and page.evaluate reads is NOT EXERCISED. (2) P3 consistency: functional U/V say 'accept the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds' but polish (prompt.md:14, judge.toml :43, :52) says only 'within 15 seconds' / 'until ... 15 seconds have passed' without that snapshot tolerance; an app at the 15 s edge could be scored differently by the two dimensions (REVIEW_POLICY: avoid one-second timing distinctions; define evidence consistently). (3) P3: hro_pol_live_board says 'Once the move is visible on this page'; a conforming app whose card details are a modal that marks the board inert/aria-hidden (golden uses a side <aside>, board.js:95,348) could hide the moved card from the accessibility snapshot; the prompt permits page.evaluate DOM reads, so this is ambiguity, not a demonstrated failure. (4) P3: cursor preservation is tested as focus plus 'typing more appends' with the caret at the end; an app that re-renders and restores value/focus with caret forced to the end would pass while moving a mid-text cursor (instruction.md:5 'moving my cursor'). The scripted golden moved the open card itself and did not measure board scroll offset, so the polish 'different card' and scroll legs are unmeasured on the golden.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening, not a blocker: add 'accept the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds' to the polish live rows to match functional; say 'present in the page (snapshot or DOM read)' instead of 'visible'; optionally place the caret mid-text and compare selectionStart before/after the live update. Obtain a full configured judge run to measure that the waits are actually performed.
